data.title: Greetings & Conversation — Starter · Lesson 8
data.subject: greetings
data.lyrics:
¡Hola! ¡Atención!

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Let's talk… Vamos a hablar
One, two, tres… Uno, dos, tres
Meet me at the market.

[Verse]
Sun's up, it's a brand new day,
Good morning… Buenos días
Fruits and veggies on display.
Chaos, colors, people sway.
Greet the vendor, smile and say,
Hello… Hola
He nods, he knows the way.
Gracias… Thank you, as I pay.
Buenas tardes… Good afternoon, I stay.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Let's talk… Vamos a hablar
One, two, tres… Uno, dos, tres
Meet me at the market.

[Verse]
I see my friend, it's time to greet,
Saluda… Greet, don't miss a beat.
Escucha… Listen to the beat of the street.
Habla… Speak up, don't be discreet.
She asks me, "¿Qué tal?" in Spanish sweet.
Pregunta… Ask away, it's neat.
Presenta… Introduce, make the meet.
Despídete… Say goodbye, it's bittersweet.

[Bridge]
Adiós… Goodbye, for now we part.
Buenas tardes… Good afternoon, with a happy heart.
Chaos fades, but the language sticks,
